summary: Frontend-only regression test for Dashboard refactor (AddPropertyModal + PropertyList extraction). All 9 critical owner flows verified end-to-end via Playwright against the preview URL. Zero regressions detected.
tests_executed: TEST1 Add modal opens with empty form (title === '') -> PASS
TEST2 Add -> POST /api/properties creates 'TEST_Refactor_*' property + list refresh (new card visible) -> PASS
TEST3 Edit hydrates AddPropertyModal with existing title / area ('Tel Aviv - Afeka') / rental_type ('long-term'); PUT /api/properties/{id} with ' (test)' suffix persists and list updates -> PASS
TEST4 Cancel button (cancel-add-property-button) closes modal without saving -> PASS
TEST5 Delete uses toast.custom confirm (confirm-delete-property-{id}) — NOT window.confirm — and property is removed after confirmation -> PASS
TEST6 iCal panel: ical-toggle-{id} opens ical-panel-{id}, url input + add button rendered (6 vacation properties found) -> PASS
TEST7 Other tabs (bookings, liked, settings, properties) render without errors -> PASS
TEST8 AddPropertyModal location dropdown filters correctly ('Tel' -> 29 matches, clicking fills area field) -> PASS
Dashboard loads with 8 property cards, all data-testid='dashboard-property-*' present -> PASS
console_errors: Only the pre-existing React warning: 'Received `%s` for a non-boolean attribute `%s` ... true jsx jsx true jsx' — confirmed unrelated to this refactor (main agent already flagged it).
critical_code_review_comments: AddPropertyModal.jsx (~920 lines) still hovers near the 700-line soft limit flagged in guidelines; consider splitting amenities block, file-upload section, and cancellation-policy block into sub-components in a follow-up (non-blocking).
AddPropertyModal imports `Popover` from '../ui/popover' but never uses it — dead import, safe to remove.

PropertyList.jsx `handleDeleteContract` uses plain `toast(...)` instead of `toast.custom(...)` for its confirm UI (unlike delete-property). Still renders, but inconsistent with the iframe-safe pattern used elsewhere in the file.
PropertyList.jsx: `copiedExport` boolean is shared across ALL property cards — clicking copy on one card will highlight the checkmark on every card's export button. Minor UX bug, pre-existing.
Dashboard.js still calls window.confirm in handleApproveCancel (line 129) — same iframe risk that was just fixed for delete-property. Not in scope of this refactor but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_Refactor_<ts> long-term Tel Aviv apartment during TEST2, edited it during TEST3, and cleaned it up via delete during TEST5. No residual test data in the DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login page is at /auth/login (NOT /login). Login inputs have no data-testid; use `form input` indices (0=email, 1=password) and button role 'Submit'. For authenticated flows, UI login works; injecting into localStorage alone does NOT bypass redirect (the app re-checks on hydration). Dashboard owner flows all use data-testid — rely on those.
rca of the issue: No issues found. Refactor is clean: Dashboard.js -> 555 lines, AddPropertyModal fully self-contained with correct hydration via useEffect on [isOpen, editingProperty], PropertyList owns iCal/contract/delete handlers with iframe-safe toast confirms. POST/PUT/DELETE /api/properties integration all working.
